messages.content:
The vulnerability (CVE-2021-25646) has been addressed by preventing user-supplied JSON from overriding the injected `JavaScriptConfig`. This was achieved by modifying `JavaScriptDimFilter.java` and `JavaScriptAggregatorFactory.java` to use field-based injection (`@JacksonInject` on the field) instead of constructor injection for the configuration object. The `@JsonCreator` constructors were updated to remove the `JavaScriptConfig` parameter, ensuring that Jackson only uses the system-configured instance.

The patch file is located at `/root/patches/CVE-2021-25646.patch`.
The project has been rebuilt with the fixes.
